title: Warm blood, cool flipper
hook: The direction of two flows changes their contact.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The red and blue arrows run in opposite directions next to each other in the toy flipper. Such vessel arrangements can transfer heat from outgoing to returning blood in some mammals, reducing heat carried outward. Actual vessel patterns vary.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: In a flipper model, which arrangement lets outgoing warm blood pass incoming cooler blood along its length?
